thread:
maria: FYI pen-test kickoff: vendor lands Mon 03/29. Need a quick plan for RBAC changes, KMS access, and which logs we'll snapshot for playback. Short sync?
ajay: +1. Can we keep the test window to a single 4h block? keeps blast radius small. also need a staging account list.
sam: 4h ok. I'll prepare a staging snapshot and a KV of current RBAC roles. sending export link once ready.
ellie: Heads up — product will freeze config changes Thu night. Any role changes must be preapproved by PMs.
maria: Noted. Priority items: 1) temporary roles for vendor (ephemeral, max 2h) 2) audit log snapshot and query samples 3) KMS decrypt path for evidence export (no key material handed over) 4) remediation tracker and retest gating.
ajay: For ephemeral roles — propose: iam:pen-test-viewer (read-only) + iam:pen-test-exec (limited runbooks). Both require OIDC-signed assertions and are timeboxed via role session policy.
sam: Implementation detail: we'll use our short-lived session token proxy. ops-bot will create presigned role URLs. Example CLI:

```
# create ephemeral role session
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pen-test-viewer --duration-seconds 3600
```

sam: We'll also add a tag pen_test=vendor and audit on tag changes.
maria: Good. About KMS: vendor needs to verify artifacts were encrypted-in-transit. We will not export private keys. Instead we'll create a wrapping key that can decrypt only an evidence bundle to a staging S3 with restricted ACLs.
ajay: Canops: schedule KMS grant window for the bundle decrypt role. Steps:
- create grant for kms:Decrypt scoped to the wrapper key
- attach grant condition: aws:PrincipalTag/pen_test=true
- revoke grant immediately after window

ajay: ops-bot can announce revoke and log it.
ops-bot: scheduled: create-kms-grant job enqueued. ETA 03/29 09:00 UTC. Will post grant_id and audit link when done. :gear:
maria: Audit log requirements: we need to capture the auth chain (principal, assumed-role, session tags), API call, and S3 object access. Query example for SOC:

```
index=audit event=CloudTrail api=AssumeRole user=arn:aws:iam::123456:user/vendor-tool
```

maria: Also snapshot DB of RBAC mapping (roles->permissions) and a csv export of policies.
sam: I'll drop a tar of /infra/configs/rbac-export-2026-03-25.tar.gz into s3://redwood-pt-artifacts/<thread_ts>/ and set object lock retention 30d.
ellie: Regarding remediation tracker — can we use a single board? prefer label schema: pen-test/critical, pen-test/major, pen-test/minor and add a retest_required boolean.
maria: Yes. We'll create a Jira board and auto-report from the vuln intake form. Retest gating: vendor must verify fix in staging with test harness; internal triage owner will validate and mark as fixed before retest slot request.
ajay: Retest slots: propose 03/31 and 04/02 evening windows. Vendor picks one after fixes. We'll reserve both but release the second if not needed.
sam: Forensics playback: we'll keep packet captures (pcap) for the staging slice and a CloudTrail segment covering the window. Note: pcaps contain secrets — store encrypted and accessible only via the wrapper key.
maria: Ops checklist for the day:
- create ephemeral roles + session policies
- create KMS grant and announce (ops-bot)
- export RBAC csv + upload artifacts
- snapshot CloudTrail and S3 access logs
- open Jira board with intake form link
- tag tickets with retest window preference

maria: Who owns the RBAC csv upload and links?
sam: I'll own the csv upload. I'll post S3 links and a checksum here once done.
ops-bot: grant created: grant_id=gr-8a3f2c, scheduled_revoke=03/29T13:00:00Z. audit_link: https://internal-logs.redwood/logs/gr-8a3f2c
sam: Uploaded rbac csv + tar: s3://redwood-pt-artifacts/1738204321/rbac-export-2026-03-25.tar.gz sha256: 7f2b...c4d
maria: ack. Ellie please confirm product freeze won't block weblab config needed for vendor tests.
ellie: Confirmed. Freeze excludes pen-test staging toggles. PM approved.
maria: Final: vendor creds will be rotated after session end; we'll schedule post-engagement debrief and evidence handoff with redaction notes. Thanks team — tagging this thread as the canonical plan. :white_check_mark:
